mgmt_bio.text: Rosa joined the company in 1996 and has worked across engineering, clinical and product development, and marketing in a range of leadership positions. His promotion reflects Intuitive's tendency to fill senior roles internally, giving the executive team deep institutional knowledge and cultural continuity. Under his leadership, capital allocation priorities remain reinvestment in the business, tuck-in acquisitions (mostly of distributors in key international markets to sell direct), and share repurchases, with the buyback authorization raised to $5bn at the end of April.
